args.body:
1. Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
2. Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
3. Combined takeaway: pricing leverage is shifting toward shippers on the spot side, so a multi-carrier volume split plus diesel-indexed surcharge monitoring offers cost advantages.

Sources: blog.corvid.example/2026/freight and insights.corvid.example/freight/companion
